audit_metadata.audit_name: Prava Payments Safety Contract Audit (13-Rule Negative Prompt Addendum)

e2e_passkey_correction_notice.playwright_headless_disclaimer: Playwright headless Chrome verified navigation and warning UI. Per Prava Rule 9, final passkey / card-network authorization requires a real browser with a platform authenticator (Face ID / Touch ID / Windows Hello). Automated headless E2E is classified as UI_REGRESSION_VERIFIED, while full passkey completion is classified as HUMAN_BROWSER_CHECK_REQUIRED.
e2e_passkey_correction_notice.real_sandbox_status: REAL_SANDBOX_GOLDEN_PATH_VERIFIED (Declined as expected in sandbox mode per provider contracts)

rule_evaluations.rule_name: NEVER put a non-routable or fake TLD in a customer email
rule_evaluations.details: validateCustomerEmail enforces real delegated TLDs and rejects .local, .test, .demo, .invalid, .localhost, .internal, .devices.

rule_evaluations.rule_name: NEVER send a malformed, fake-TLD, or full-path merchant URL
rule_evaluations.details: validateMerchantUrl enforces bare https origins on delegated TLDs, throwing on scheme typos, HTTP, subpaths, and banned TLDs.

rule_evaluations.rule_name: NEVER invent card numbers in sandbox
rule_evaluations.details: APPROVED_SANDBOX_TEST_CARDS defines verified test PANs with exact published expiry and CVV.

rule_evaluations.rule_name: NEVER funnel many users/devices onto one shared test card
rule_evaluations.details: Multiple sandbox test cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex) are provided to distribute session tokens and avoid single-token binding cap limits.
getDurableBrowserProfileId reads and persists prava_bpid in localStorage once per browser.
isDeterministicPaymentError identifies deterministic errors (PASSKEY_REG_FAILED, BINDING_LIMIT_EXCEEDED, etc.) to block automatic retries.

rule_evaluations.rule_name: NEVER send Content-Type: application/json with an empty body
rule_evaluations.details: sessionClient.ts automatically supplies body: '{}' for POST requests with Content-Type: application/json.

rule_evaluations.rule_name: NEVER poll Prava endpoints in a tight loop
rule_evaluations.details: Payment result polling operates on minimum 2-3s intervals with 30s overall timeout and cached mandate states.

rule_evaluations.rule_name: NEVER run the checkout inside an embedded webview without platform authenticator
rule_evaluations.details: checkPlatformAuthenticatorAvailable detects WebAuthn / platform authenticators. Headless Chrome displays warning UI; real passkey checkout requires Windows Hello / Touch ID.

rule_evaluations.rule_name: NEVER assume third-party cookies/storage are available
rule_evaluations.details: Cross-origin storage / cookie block warnings are displayed gracefully when iframe access is restricted.

rule_evaluations.rule_name: NEVER let the OTP screen sit idle (5-minute expiry & resend window)
rule_evaluations.details: OTP 5-minute expiry timer is enforced, distinguishing OTP_EXPIRED from incorrect code, with up to 3 resends allowed.

rule_evaluations.rule_name: NEVER submit card fields without validating them client-side
rule_evaluations.details: validateCardFields validates cardholder name, 13-19 digit PAN, MM/YYYY expiry, and 3-4 digit CVV before submitting.
sessionClient.ts extracts and surfaces exact provider error code and message.
